v3 screen control: c2 (efficientnet_b0, slot attention, 8 epochs, steven_v4) on the prep v2 six-slot table with absent slots packed out of the backbone. Pairs against the 19-slot arm in the same session; read unpaired against the unpacked c2 confirm fold-0 row for what packing alone did.

v3 screen: the same c2 config on the prep v3 table, plane x fat suppression x T1/PD/T2/UNK. The census found every v2 STRUCT slot mixing contrasts; the risk is sparsity, mean 5.04 of 19 filled. Worth a 5-fold confirm only if the paired val CI lower bound is above zero.

f1: ConvNeXt-tiny (in12k, apache-2.0, no BatchNorm) in place of efficientnet_b0 on c2's six-slot attention config and recipe. A CNN from a different pretraining set and normalisation, judged by its gain added to the c2+c3 fold-0 ensemble.
f2: EVA02-small (MIM in22k, MIT, no BatchNorm) on the same config with c3's differential AdamW recipe. A ViT pretrained differently from DINOv2, judged by its gain added to the c2+c3 fold-0 ensemble.

Resolution screen control: c2 (six v2 slots, attention, efficientnet_b0, 8 epochs, steven_v4, packed) at 224px batch 8. Pairs with s3 and with the accumulated arm, and as a fourth member next to c2+c3+f1 it prices one more model of a known config.

s3: the control with per-label confidence weights on the training loss, from agreement among four independent label sources. Weak prior: disagreement correlated +0.40 with gold AUC across labels, the wrong sign, and the weights only act within label.

Accumulation control: the control at batch 4 with 2 accumulated steps, so the optimizer batch is unchanged and only BatchNorm sees fewer studies. Pairs with the control to measure accumulation alone, and with s2 so resolution is the only variable there.

s2: 336px read (artifacts are stored at 336) at batch 4 x 2 accumulated, because batch 8 does not fit a T4 at 336. Judged as a replacement against the accumulated 224 arm and as a member next to c2+c3+f1 against the control arm bar.

Screen B control: c2 (six v2 slots, slot attention, efficientnet_b0, 8 epochs, packed) on steven_v4, the promoted target. Scored on steven_v4 binarised and on gold like every arm.

t1: one head per label source (ours, steven_v4, pilkwang_v2, lixin73), 48 logits, masked BCE skipping the NaN where a source never rated a study; the four readings are averaged at inference. The multi-source target without the rank blend's destroyed prevalence.
t2: the probability mean of the three best independent sources on gold (steven_v4, ours, lixin73) as one soft target -- prevalence preserved, unlike the rank blend rejected in Phase 6.

Screen A control: c2 (six v2 slots, slot attention, efficientnet_b0, 8 epochs, steven_v4, packed) reading the fixed five groups of the 9-group artifact -- prep v2 pixel for pixel. As a fifth member next to c2+c3+f1+s2 it prices one more model of a known config.

a1: per-diagnosis attention over every (slot, group) token instead of the mean over a slot's groups. The 9-group reads gained +0.005 to +0.009 with nothing retrained, so the windows carry signal the mean discards; this head can weigh the window that shows the finding.
a2: a1 trained on five random groups of the nine stored each epoch (eval at the fixed five), so the model sees the in-between windows the confirms never trained on.
a3: a1 with EMA weights (decay 0.999, one update per optimizer step). Scored twice: EMA against its own raw weights is the EMA effect; raw against a1 is the run-to-run noise.
